title: Compare remote access
responsibility: Identify the connected computer, phone and grant so views can react to access changes.

inputs.name: remoteAuthority.status
inputs.description: The phone's remote status, read for its host id, device id and grant, which together identify whose data may be shown. A null host or device contributes an empty string to the holder, a null grant serializes as the text 'null', and a null or undefined status throws a TypeError.

examples.reason: The computer is asleep or has no network.

inputs.name: authorityChange.known
inputs.description: The holder and serialized grant the page's content was read under, as previously remembered. A null holder means no holder was known, so a change from no holder is reported as 'grant' rather than 'holder'.

inputs.name: authorityChange.next
inputs.description: The holder and serialized grant observed now, to compare with known. A holder from remoteAuthority is never null: it is '/' when both host and device are null.

inputs.name: authorityChange.steady
inputs.description: Whether the connection stayed steady between the two observations. Only a steady connection with an identical authority yields 'none'; otherwise the result is 'holder' or 'grant'.

inputs.name: excludes.status
inputs.description: The phone's remote status whose grant.projects is searched for the project. A null grant excludes every non-null project, and a null or undefined status throws a TypeError only when projectId is not null.

examples.reason: The computer is asleep or has no network.

inputs.name: excludes.projectId
inputs.description: The project id to look up in grant.projects, or null when no project is selected. Null always gives false, while a non-null id that is missing from the grant (or from a null grant) gives true.

outputs.name: noAuthority
outputs.description: The exported starting authority, with no holder (null) and an empty grant string. It is one shared object, not a new one for each use.

outputs.name: remoteAuthority
outputs.description: The holder is the host id and device id joined by '/', each an empty string when absent, so it is never null. The grant is JSON.stringify of status.grant: the text 'null' for a null grant, and undefined rather than a string when the grant is undefined.

outputs.name: authorityChange
outputs.description: The kind of change, one of the strings 'none', 'holder' or 'grant': 'none' for a steady, identical authority; 'holder' only when known.holder is not null and differs from next.holder; 'grant' otherwise.

outputs.name: excludes
outputs.description: True when projectId is not null and no entry of grant.projects has that id, including when the grant is null; false when projectId is null.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when a status, known or next argument that the function reads is null or undefined: remoteAuthority and authorityChange always read theirs, and excludes reads status only when projectId is not null. excludes also throws it for a non-null grant with no projects list or a null entry the search reaches, and remoteAuthority throws it for a grant that JSON.stringify cannot serialize (a BigInt or a circular reference).

outputs.description: The kind of change, one of the strings 'none', 'holder' or 'grant': 'none' for a steady, identical authority; 'holder' only when known.holder is not null and differs from next.holder; 'grant' otherwise.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when known or next is null or undefined, because their holder and grant fields are read without a guard.

outputs.name: excludes
outputs.description: True when projectId is not null and no entry of grant.projects has that id, including when the grant is null; false when projectId is null.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when projectId is not null and status is null or undefined, or when status.grant is non-null but has no projects list or a null entry that the search reaches. A null projectId never reads status.
